newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: TECHNICALS DRIVE SIMEX BRENT FUTURES.
newsitem.headline: TECHNICALS DRIVE SIMEX BRENT FUTURES.

text.p: September Brent futures were untraded at midday on Monday, and quoted within the range of London's close.
SIMEX Brent was quoted widely between $18.42/18.65 per barrel for September, with London settling at $18.48, after falling 42 cents on the U.N.'s approval of Iraqi crude exports.
Singapore brokers saw $18.00 as the next support level, but they were optimistic that prices would still rise over the week.
"It will be more driven by technicals than by fundamentals," said one broker.
"The volumes traded during the price fall was quite small. Once prices touch $18.50, then fund managers will start buying again," he added.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded at $19.60, after New York fell 55 cents to $19.54.
